Resolves #1069
Related: #15000

Wires horizontal `scroll` events on `.neo-c-w-scrollcontainer` into `Neo.calendar.view.week.Component` infinite-scroll column paging (`onScroll` -> `onWheel` when `deltaX !== 0`), assigns deterministic column/header VDOM IDs in `createColumnAndHeader`, and restores the main-thread `scrollContainerId` handshake in `Neo.calendar.view.week.plugin.DragDrop#getEventDragZone` and `Neo.calendar.view.week.EventDragZone#dragStart`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (unit-testable week-view scroll paging and `EventDragZone` `scrollContainerId` handshake).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #1069.
| Prose intent | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Scroll events on `.neo-c-w-scrollcontainer` (including drag-scroll at left/right edges) trigger infinite-scroll column paging and `scrollBy` compensation while ignoring vertical-only scroll events | `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` (`onScroll pages buffered columns at right and left edges, preserves deterministic column/header IDs, and ignores vertical scroll on the scroll container (#1069)` & `week.plugin.DragDrop#getEventDragZone and EventDragZone#dragStart sync scrollContainerId across multiple drags (#1069)`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Restored the `scrollContainerId` main-thread handshake in `EventDragZone#dragStart` (`Neo.main.addon.DragDrop.setConfigs`) and `week/plugin/DragDrop#getEventDragZone` (`config.scrollContainerId`), which had drifted after `#1245` (`bed4ea72f3`), and initialized `clientX`/`clientY` in `Neo.main.addon.DragDrop#onDragStart`.
- Populated deterministic column and header VDOM IDs (`getColumnId(date)`, `getColumnHeaderId(date)`) in `WeekComponent#createColumnAndHeader` to match `updateHeader()` so `EventDragZone#dragMove` resolves the right drop day from `targetPath` after mid-drag column paging.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required beyond CI unit/component suites.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge (blocking, RA-1).** In the week view, `.neo-c-w-scrollcontainer` is the only `overflow: auto` element (`resources/scss/src/calendar/view/week/Component.scss` l.33–37). `.neo-c-w-column-timeaxis-container` has `min-width: calc(300% - 100px)` and no overflow (l.55–59), so it never scrolls. Both axes therefore scroll on the scroll container, and every vertical scroll event:
1. passes `onScroll`'s target filter, because its target is the scroll container;
2. computes `deltaX = 0`, then gets coerced to `+1` (or to `-1` at `scrollLeft === 0`);
3. calls `onWheel`, which runs `getColumnContainer()`, `getHeaderContainer()` and the edge arithmetic. A vertical scroll streams events, so this runs at frame rate. At `scrollLeft === 0`, the coerced `-1` also satisfies the left-edge condition and pages backward with no horizontal movement at all.

The spec cannot see any of this: its vertical arm dispatches on the time-axis container, which the filter rejects for a reason the browser never produces.

**Non-blocking polish:** `me.scrollLeft` is an undeclared instance property on a component. Declare the last-seen horizontal position as a documented class field, for example `lastScrollLeft = null`, so it can't be mistaken for a DOM-mirrored config.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit (per guide §7.4):**

- [ ] PR description: the spec title and the AC table say vertical scroll is ignored. That holds only for an element that never scrolls (RA-1).
- [x] Anchor & Echo summaries: precise. `createColumnAndHeader`'s and `onWheel`'s new summaries match the code.
- [x] `[RETROSPECTIVE]` tag: none in the body.
- [x] Linked anchors: #1245's drift is the stated reason for restoring the handshake, and the `dragStart` diff matches it.

**Findings:** one drift, folded into RA-1. The claim "ignores vertical timeaxis scroll" is true only on a path that does not exist.
